title: Anti-Inflammatory, Antioxidant, Molecular Docking and Pharmacokinetics Properties of Cycloeucalenone Isolated From Musa x paradisiaca L. Fruit Peels.
authors: Ali, Ibeabuchi J; Olofinsan, Kolawole A; Ikeh, Goodnews O; Okorie, Ndidiamaka H; Adonu, Cyril C; Omeh, Romanus C; Idoko, Blessing C; Nnamani, Pamela E
one_liner_zh: 该研究从香蕉皮中分离环木菠萝烯酮并评估其抗炎抗氧化活性及对小分子靶点的分子对接，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study isolated a compound with anti-inflammatory properties from Musa x paradisiaca fruit peels. The methanol extract was partitioned, and the hexane fraction with the best bioactivity was subjected to column chromatography before characterization via Fourier transform infrared (FTIR), UV-visible (UV-VIS) and NMR analysis. The in vivo anti-inflammatory properties of the methanol extract and hexane fraction were investigated using the formalin-induced oedema model in rats. The compound's antioxidant, red blood cell (RBC) membrane stabilization and phospholipase-A2 (PL-A2) inhibitory effects were evaluated in vitro. The UV-VIS spectrum at 222 nm absorbance and FTIR absorption at 2922, 2855, 1707, 1643, 1453 and 1375 cm(-1) with proton and carbon-13 spectra suggest the compound is a steroid. The in vivo anti-inflammatory assay showed significant oedema reduction of the hexane fraction at 200 mg/kg. The compound also displayed Fe(3+) reduction and scavenged free radical molecules while showing PL-A2 inhibition and the ability to limit RBC haemolysis. The compound also presented stronger affinities for PL-A2 (-7.6 kcal/mol) and NF-kappaB (-6.0 kcal/mol) than indomethacin and ibuprofen drugs, with a favourable pharmacokinetic model. Though M. x paradisiaca fruit peels are often discarded as waste, our study highlights a sustainable approach to the reutilization of this plant material as a source of a lead molecule for inflammatory disease management.
abstract_zh: 本研究从Musa x paradisiaca果皮中分离出一种具有抗炎活性的化合物。甲醇提取物经分配后，将生物活性最佳的己烷馏分进行柱层析，随后通过傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）、紫外-可见光谱（UV-VIS）和核磁共振（NMR）分析进行表征。采用大鼠福尔马林诱导水肿模型，研究了甲醇提取物和己烷馏分的体内抗炎特性。体外评估了该化合物的抗氧化、红细胞（RBC）膜稳定及磷脂酶A2（PL-A2）抑制效应。UV-VIS光谱在222 nm处有吸收，FTIR在2922、2855、1707、1643、1453和1375 cm(-1)处有吸收，结合质子和碳-13谱，提示该化合物为类固醇。体内抗炎实验显示，己烷馏分在200 mg/kg剂量下显著减轻水肿。该化合物还表现出Fe(3+)还原能力、清除自由基分子，并具有PL-A2抑制活性和限制红细胞溶血的作用。此外，该化合物对PL-A2（-7.6 kcal/mol）和NF-kappaB（-6.0 kcal/mol）的亲和力强于吲哚美辛和布洛芬，且药代动力学模型良好。尽管M. x paradisiaca果皮常被作为废弃物丢弃，但我们的研究突显了一种可持续的方法，将该植物材料再利用为炎症性疾病管理的先导分子来源。
